mentions.name: Voice-controlled smart ring
mentions.description: A smart ring that users talk into to control an agent on their phone, so spoken commands carry out real-world actions — for example saying "pick me up" summons an Uber.
mentions.source_excerpt: A ring you can talk into and it controls an agent on your phone. Eg say "pick me up" and an Uber arrives.

evidence.value: A ring you can talk into and it controls an agent on your phone. Eg say "pick me up" and an Uber arrives.
